rubric.description: Critically reflect upon issues, concepts, theories and perspectives relevant to the subject, developing & evaluating complex arguments.

levels.name: Insufficient
levels.description: Descriptive, sometimes illogical or contradictory. Generalisations/statements made with scant evidence/references. Conclusions lack relevance validity.

levels.name: Satisfactory
levels.description: Devises an argument/position on complex concepts and theories supported by appropriately selected and evaluated evidence/references to support own views and introduce other perspectives.

levels.name: Good
levels.description: Devises logical arguments/position on complex concepts and theories supported by appropriately selected and evaluated evidence/references from a wider range to support own views and emerging evaluation other perspectives.

levels.name: Very Good
levels.description: Devises coherent substantiated and thoughtful arguments/position on complex concepts and theories supported by critically evaluated evidence/ references from a good range to evaluate and synthesise a range of views.

levels.name: Excellent
levels.description: Coherent substantiated and sophisticated arguments/position on complex concepts and theories supported by critically evaluated evidence/ references from a broad range to evaluate and synthesise a range of views with critical insight.

levels.name: Outstanding
levels.description: Coherent original substantiated and sophisticated arguments/position on complex concepts and theories supported by critically evaluated references from a comprehensive range to evaluate and synthesise a range of views critical insight.

rubric.description: Create and implement solutions to complex problems, using a range of problem solving tools and techniques.

levels.name: Insufficient
levels.description: Demonstrated an ability to apply a method appropriately to solve problems and make decisions in complex circumstances.

levels.name: Satisfactory
levels.description: Consistently demonstrated an ability to apply a range of methods appropriately to solve problems and make decisions in complex circumstances.

levels.name: Good
levels.description: Consistently demonstrated thorough ability to apply a range of methods appropriately to solve problems and make decisions in complex circumstances with some autonomy.

levels.name: Very Good
levels.description: Consistently demonstrated thorough ability to justify the application of range of methods appropriately to solve problems and make decisions in complex circumstances with some autonomy.

levels.name: Excellent
levels.description: Consistently demonstrated thorough ability to justify the application of range of well-developed methods to solve problems and make decisions in complex circumstances with a high degree of autonomy.

levels.name: Outstanding
levels.description: Consistently demonstrated thorough ability to justify the application of range of innovative (or innovatively employed) methods to solve problems and make decisions in complex circumstances with significant autonomy.

rubric.description: Critically evaluate political, social and environmental issues related to professional contexts.

levels.name: Insufficient
levels.description: Descriptive generalised statements made with scant evidence/references.

levels.name: Satisfactory
levels.description: Devises an argument/position on complex issues and challenges supported by appropriately selected and evaluated evidence/references to support own views and introduce other perspectives.

levels.name: Good
levels.description: Devises logical arguments/position on complex issues and challenges supported by appropriately selected and evaluated evidence/ references from a wider range to support own views and emerging evaluation other perspectives.

levels.name: Very Good
levels.description: Devises coherent substantiated and thoughtful arguments/position on issues and challenges supported by critically evaluated evidence/ references from a good range to evaluate and synthesise a range of views.

levels.name: Excellent
levels.description: Coherent substantiated and sophisticated arguments/position on complex on issues and challenges supported by critically evaluated evidence/ references from a broad range to evaluate and synthesise a range of views with critical insight.

levels.name: Outstanding
levels.description: Coherent original substantiated and sophisticated arguments/position on issues and challenges supported by critically evaluated references from a comprehensive range to evaluate and synthesise a range of views critical insight.

rubric.description: Critically evaluate and employ theories, skills and techniques to achieve practical outcomes in complex real world contexts/scenarios.

levels.name: Insufficient
levels.description: Limited evidence of ability to identify tools and methods appropriately and little evidence of application in the real world.

levels.name: Satisfactory
levels.description: The student has employed theories and skills to complete practical tasks and/or processes accurately and with a degree of independence.

levels.name: Good
levels.description: The student has employed theories and skills accurately to proficiently complete practical tasks and/or processes and with a degree of independence.

levels.name: Very Good
levels.description: The student has employed theories and skills accurately to autonomously and proficiently complete practical tasks and/or processes.

levels.name: Excellent
levels.description: Employed theories and skills to autonomously and complete practical tasks and/or processes with a high degree of accuracy, coordination and proficiency.

levels.name: Outstanding
levels.description: Employed theories and skills to autonomously and complete practical tasks and/or processes with a high degree of innovation, accuracy, coordination and proficiency.

rubric.description: Employ a range of digital tools to solve complex problems and support excellent communication.

levels.name: Insufficient
levels.description: Employed a range of digital tools, but followed a limited, procedural or mechanistic formula when problem solving and/or communicating, with little or no independence.

levels.name: Satisfactory
levels.description: Employed a range of digital tools accurately to solve problems and communicate effectively, with a degree of independence.

levels.name: Good
levels.description: Employed digital tools accurately to solve problems and communicate effectively, mainly independently in an accurate, well-coordinated and proficient way.

levels.name: Very Good
levels.description: Employed digital tools accurately to solve problems and communicate effectively, autonomously, with accuracy and coordination.

levels.name: Excellent
levels.description: Autonomously employed digital tools accurately to solve problems and communicate effectively, with a high degree of accuracy, coordination and proficiency.

levels.name: Outstanding
levels.description: Autonomously employed digital tools accurately to solve problems and communicate effectively, with an outstanding degree of accuracy, coordination and proficiency.

rubric.description: Critically evaluate and employ professional and ethical working practices, acting in the best interest of the organisation.

levels.name: Insufficient
levels.description: Descriptive generalised statements made with scant evidence/references. Little initiative/personal responsibility and ability to manage learning/work with minimal supervision.

levels.name: Satisfactory
levels.description: Evaluation of professional practices/issues. Demonstration of initiative/personal responsibility and ability to manage learning/work with minimal supervision.

levels.name: Good
levels.description: Good critical evaluation of professional practices/issues. Demonstration of initiative/personal responsibility and ability to manage learning/work without supervision.

levels.name: Very Good
levels.description: Very Good critical evaluation of professional practices/issues and decision making. Well developed, systematic demonstration of initiative/personal responsibility and ability to manage learning/work without supervision.

levels.name: Excellent
levels.description: Excellent critical evaluation of professional practices/issues and decision making. exceptional, systematic application of initiative/ personal responsibility and ability to manage learning/work without supervision.

levels.name: Outstanding
levels.description: Outstanding, fluent critical evaluation of professional practices/issues and decision making. exceptional, systematic application of initiative/personal responsibility and ability to manage learning/work without supervision.

rubric.description: Apply collaboration processes to facilitate effective working relationships, share ideas and address complex challenges for mutual benefit.

levels.name: Insufficient
levels.description: Shown limited evidence of facilitating working relationships or group discussions to address challenges with limited initiative or personal responsibility.

levels.name: Satisfactory
levels.description: Demonstrated capability in facilitating working relationships or group discussions to address challenges, demonstrating some initiative and/or personal responsibility.

levels.name: Good
levels.description: Demonstrated the capability to facilitate working relationships or group discussions to address challenges, consistently demonstrating initiative and/or personal responsibility.

levels.name: Very Good
levels.description: Demonstrated the capability to make strong, valuable contributions to facilitate working relationships or group discussions to address challenges, consistently demonstrating well-developed initiatives and/or personal responsibility.

levels.name: Excellent
levels.description: Demonstrated the capability to make excellent, valuable contributions to facilitate working relationships or group discussions to address challenges, consistently demonstrating well-developed initiatives and/or personal responsibility.

levels.name: Outstanding
levels.description: Demonstrated the capability to make outstanding, valuable contributions to facilitate working relationships or group discussions to address challenges, consistently demonstrating well-developed initiatives and/or personal responsibility.

rubric.description: Employ a range of ideas that inform evidence-based decision making.

levels.name: Insufficient
levels.description: Demonstrated a limited ability to solve problems, lacking the required breadth or depth to make informed evidence-based decisions.

levels.name: Satisfactory
levels.description: Demonstrated an ability to solve problems, apply depth of knowledge and understanding in key aspects of their field to make informed evidence-based decisions.

levels.name: Good
levels.description: Demonstrated an ability to solve complex problems, applying sound breadth and depth of subject knowledge, selecting and applying a range of appropriate ideas to make informed evidence-based decisions.

levels.name: Very Good
levels.description: Demonstrated thorough problem-solving skills, selecting and justifying their use of a wide-range of ideas, to make informed evidence-based decisions in complex and unpredictable circumstances with a degree of autonomy.

levels.name: Excellent
levels.description: Demonstrated excellent problem-solving skills, selecting and justifying their use of a wide-range of ideas, to make informed evidence-based decisions in complex and unpredictable circumstances with a high degree of autonomy.

levels.name: Outstanding
levels.description: Demonstrated outstanding problem-solving skills, selecting and justifying their use of a wide-range of ideas, to make informed evidence-based decisions in complex and unpredictable circumstances with a high degree of autonomy.

rubric.description: Critique and employ a wide range of discipline-specific theories, concepts and skills, for complex business contexts.

levels.name: Insufficient
levels.description: Gaps in knowledge and superficial understanding of core knowledge and skills. Some inaccuracies.

levels.name: Satisfactory
levels.description: Demonstrable application knowledge and skills core to the discipline.

levels.name: Good
levels.description: Consistent demonstration and application of discipline knowledge and skills.

levels.name: Very Good
levels.description: Capable and effective demonstration and application of discipline knowledge and skills.

levels.name: Excellent
levels.description: Professionally accomplished demonstration and application of discipline knowledge and skills. A awareness of multiple perspectives in of theory in the knowledge base.

levels.name: Outstanding
levels.description: Accomplished and innovative application of discipline knowledge and skills. Awareness of multiple perspectives and the ambiguities and limitations of knowledge.

rubric.description: Communicate arguments and reasoning effectively, with a good understanding of audience and purpose within complex business contexts.

levels.name: Insufficient
levels.description: Communication may have some merit but is inappropriately pitched for the audience

levels.name: Satisfactory
levels.description: Communicates in a range of formats appropriate to the discipline(s) audience and context with clear expression. Adequate numeracy and literacy skills.

levels.name: Good
levels.description: Communicates confidently in a range of formats appropriate to the discipline(s) audience and context with clear, coherent expression. Good numeracy and literacy skills.

levels.name: Very Good
levels.description: Communicates proficiently in a range of formats appropriate to the discipline(s) audience and context with fluent coherent expression. Very Good numeracy and literacy skills.

levels.name: Excellent
levels.description: Accomplished communication of arguments and reasoning very effectively in a range of formats, appropriate to the discipline(s) audience and context. Excellent numeracy and literacy skills.

levels.name: Outstanding
levels.description: Accomplished communication of arguments and reasoning originally in a range of formats, appropriate to the discipline(s) audience and context.Exceptional numeracy and literacy skills
